sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your counter-offer and are willing to commit to a 24-month contract to ensure stability for both sides. 

For our primary proposal, we can offer a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. However, as a family-run business, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for us.

As another option, with a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.80 per unit. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our long-standing relationship mean a great deal to our family foundry, and we take pride in the quality our team produces for you. As a reliable partner, we expect negotiations to progress constructively rather than moving backward.

We must therefore maintain our previous offer of €52.20 for 60-day payment terms. For complete clarity, our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust that this reflects our continued commitment to working together productively and looking after our mutual interests.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We are disappointed to see your price offer decrease once again, which does not reflect a constructive negotiation. As a reliable partner, we expect serious steps towards an agreement, not backward movement.

We must firmly hold our offer of a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our family foundry has always valued long-standing partnerships built on mutual respect and trust. We remain committed to working together, but we need to see genuine progress from your side as well.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
